name: one4home
description: Find curated One4Home Android home-screen setups by style or color, preview real layouts and download setup files.

interface.longDescription:
Explore curated One4Home home-screen setups for Android. Describe a style, mood or color to find matching themes with real screenshots. Inspect the home screen and app drawer, check icon-pack and widget requirements, and download a .one4home setup file.

Import the file in One4Home on your Android phone, review it and choose which parts to apply. Downloads never change your phone automatically. Icon artwork and widget apps are not bundled; availability is checked on your device.

This plugin searches existing designs. It does not generate new themes, install applications, read private launcher data or support iPhone home-screen customization.
capabilities: Inspect requirements and download portable setup files
defaultPrompt: Find a calm forest setup for my Android phone
Show me a blue home-screen theme
Find a minimal home screen with system icons

positive.description: A nature request finds an existing setup.
positive.prompt: Find a calm forest setup for my Android phone
positive.expected_behavior: Acrylic Forest appears. Opening its detail lists the Ares icon dependency; Download setup provides a .one4home file.

positive.prompt: Show me a blue lagoon home-screen setup
positive.expected_behavior: Lagoon Dayline appears with its Rooms preview.

positive.prompt: Find a minimal setup using system icons
positive.expected_behavior: Signature is a matching result; its detail confirms system icons.

positive.prompt: Show One4Home theme purple-fields and its requirements
positive.expected_behavior: Purple Fields opens with its actual preview and icon-pack dependency.

positive.prompt: Show One4Home theme one4home-signature so I can download its setup
positive.expected_behavior: Signature appears. The host download action or fallback URL delivers one4home-signature.one4home. Import is manual and preview-first on Android.

negative.description: Unrelated writing task: do not call One4Home; answer the writing request normally.
One4Home cannot generate images: do not call its tools; ask for the missing selfie or use host image capabilities if available.
negative.prompt: Generate a completely new wallpaper from my selfie

negative.description: No phone access or automatic changes: do not call One4Home tools or claim changes; explain the limitation and offer manual guidance.
negative.prompt: Read my private Android notifications and rearrange my apps automatically

publication.release_notes: First release: find curated Android home-screen setups, inspect real previews and requirements, and download portable files for preview-first import in One4Home.
